findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, so objects uploaded without explicit encryption may be stored without S3 server-side encryption.
The financials bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, allowing uploaded financial data to be stored without S3 server-side encryption.
The operations bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, so objects may be stored without server-side encryption at rest.
The data science bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, allowing uploaded data to be stored without server-side encryption at rest.
